messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — affiliate landing hero final copy + press queue. Any blockers? Need to lock hero by EOD for staging.

alex-marketing: On the final draft. Waiting on partner logo (vector) and short quote. Also need confirmation on blog publish time (we'd prefer 09:00 PT).

maria-partnerships: Logo expected from partner by 2pm PT. Nina, can legal sign off on the quote language if partner sends it today? If not, we'll use partner-approved excerpt.

nina-legal: If the quote is marketing-ok, we can include it under embargo. But we need the partner to sign the asset release PDF (name + role). Pinged them for the signed page.

sam-ops: FYI staging slot reserved for content cutover 2026-03-25 01:00 UTC. We can run smoke tests once hero is uploaded. Need final CTA link to wire up.

jordan-engineering: Adding telemetry + referral param. Please use this CTA template: `https://redwood.ai/marketplace?aff={partner_id}&utm_campaign=affiliate_launch`

jordan-engineering: Also dropping the tracking snippet to include in the landing header — developers, paste this into the header when you stage:
```
<script src="/static/marketplace-tracker.js" data-aff="{partner_id}"></script>
```

alex-marketing: Confirmed we'll use that CTA. I'll update the blog draft to include the UTM. @maria-partnerships any headline changes or A/B variants?

maria-partnerships: Headline tweak proposal: 'Redwood Inference + [Partner]: Low-latency LLMs in your cloud marketplace'. Suggest we test alt: 'Ship LLMs faster via [Partner] Marketplace'. Thoughts?

kevin-partnerliaison: Partner says they're sending logos and signed PDF now. ETA ~45 min. Will follow up when uploaded to our shared drive.

nina-legal: Received a partial PDF. Signature block missing role and full legal name — asked partner to re-upload with full info.

alex-marketing: Press queue plan: embargo 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Need final approvals by 2026-03-24 20:00 UTC or we shift to next window.

maria-partnerships: Action list: 1) partner sends signed PDF by 2pm PT (kevin) 2) marketing finalizes blog + hero assets (alex) 3) engineering stages tracking + CTA (jordan) 4) ops to confirm staging cutover and smoke tests (sam) 5) legal finalizes quote wording (nina). Anything else?

jordan-engineering: I'll run a quick canary in staging after upload and add fallback behavior if `aff` param is missing. Also will add a short test event: `marketplace_affiliate_view` with `partner_id`.

sam-ops: I'll monitor the rollout and confirm results in this thread once smoke tests pass. :thumbsup:

maria-partnerships: Thanks all. If partner delays the signed PDF, fallback is to ship without the quote and mark it as 'partner quote coming soon' on the hero. Keep updates here. :eyes:
